response.rationale: The item is electronics delivered 33 days ago (>15 days), so RET-003 applies making it ineligible. This priority-20 electronics rule dominates the standard-window rule RET-008 (priority 10). Higher-priority rules do not apply: not final sale (RET-012), not defective (RET-020, defective is null), no goodwill grant (RET-050), and no fraud hold (RET-051). Loyalty is framing and not a policy factor.
